name: What should I prepare before starting a custom home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting a custom home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a custom home renovation, it's beneficial to have a clear understanding of your goals, desired aesthetic, and budget. Gather inspirational images, create a list of 'must-haves' versus 'nice-to-haves,' and consider your long-term needs for the space. Research potential contractors and interview a few to find the right fit. Having a general idea of your vision and a realistic budget will streamline the design and planning phases, leading to a smoother project execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by defining your goals, desired aesthetic, and budget, gathering inspiration, and researching contractors to ensure a smooth planning process.
